articles.summary: TOANO, Va., Oct. 23, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CF Financial Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ: CFFI), the holding company for CF Bank, today reported consolidated net income of $7.1 million for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 31.2 percent compared to $5.4 million for the third quarter of 2024. articles.title: C&F Financial Corporation Announces Net Income for Third Quarter and First Nine Months
